name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Waco TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (pano 4FCsQp4AotyqmOmfOonT_A, 2022-04, heading ~306-340) shows two red/white striped barrier arms across separate lanes with a raised concrete median island where the truck drive meets Corporation Pkwy.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Same gate frame shows a small staffed booth on the left with a STOP sign and traffic cones, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, windows on multiple sides, set beside the gate lanes. Classic guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a manned guard shack is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single combined gate complex with an in lane and an out lane split by a median island at one point on the property line off Corporation Pkwy.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound lane at the gate; barrier-arm split suggests one in / one out. Low confidence on exact lane split.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 outbound lane (the second barrier-arm lane).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron just inside the gate before the dock approach; trucks can hold here. Pre-gate (street-side) staging not present, road frontage is narrow.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach and large internal yard easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long NE building face has trailers backed into a continuous dock bank (40+ doors) and a second dock bank on the SW face with trailers backed in; total across both faces is well into 50+ band. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large dedicated trailer-storage lot on the SW/W side with many rows of parked trailers (well over 50 stalls). 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock banks on different building faces (NE wall and SW wall), consistent with separate ship/receive flows. Medium confidence; could be one continuous operation.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot full of parked trailers separate from active dock staging on the SW side.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line/spur runs along the NE side parallel to Corporation Pkwy adjacent to the property; treated as rail-served. Spur may serve the corridor rather than terminating in the building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park SW of Waco against open land and a wooded creek to the south; judged Rural per rubric tie-break toward small-town industrial.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False; sits in an active business park with adjacent office/medical development, so cellular coverage is likely adequate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~31 acres from the traced perimeter polygon (building + drop yard + parking + apron).
